about: The collecta of the formulary “Most Holy Name of Jesus” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, who appointed Your only-begotten Son as Savior of the human race and commanded Him to be called Jesus, mercifully grant that we who venerate His holy name on earth may also enjoy the sight of Him in heaven. Through this same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: as Savior of the human race
commanded that He be called Jesus
we who venerate His holy name on earth
may also enjoy the sight of Him
this same Jesus Christ, our Lord
